hero.lead: Tarafder Informatics Ltd. is a community of volunteers who help learners and builders tackle Complex Engineering Problems, visualize difficult concepts, and grow ideas into real ventures.

focus.text: Problem solving, visual understanding and entrepreneurial action — taught, practiced and shared by volunteers who want to see others grow.

cards.title: Complex Engineering Problems
cards.text: Guidance for framing, analysing and solving open-ended problems with conflicting requirements, many stakeholders and no single right answer.

cards.title: Concept Visualization
cards.text: Abstract ideas become diagrams, animations and interactive explainers — so theory is something you can see, poke and truly understand.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship
cards.text: From a rough idea to a validated concept and a confident pitch — practical mentoring for first-time founders and student builders.

band.title: Have a problem, an idea or time to give?
band.text: Whether you want to learn, mentor or build — there is a place for you at Tarafder Informatics Ltd.
